live-tail.about: Live tail's replay (`query: "loop"`): pages aren't the plain file's, so the plain-file runs skip them (and check `summary`, the open's by range of `file`). Row i reads `loop_file` (the file fetched whole and registered as a File) at row i mod `file_rows`, its time moved on by i div `file_rows` laps of `span_s` seconds: one SELECT per lap the page crosses, in row order. Each side formats the TIMESTAMP (cells.json's `timestamp_text`). Run by the GPUI contender's `src/tail.rs` and the TanStack contender's `test/tail.test.ts`, with controls (no shift, the seam read as one SELECT, a lap off by one); prep (`data/prep.ts`) runs each page in native DuckDB against the file's rows.
